sloka: सम्यच्च वाजिनाम् रश्मीन् सूत याहि शनैः शनैः ।मुखम् द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य दुर्दर्शम् नो भविष्यति ॥२-४०-२२॥
transliteration: samyacca vājinām raśmīn sūta yāhi śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।mukham drakṣyāmi rāmasya durdarśam no bhaviṣyati ॥2-40-22॥

translations.english: O charioteer, control the reins of the horses and go slow so that we may look at the face of Rama, for soon we will not be able to see him.
